passage.text: It's Sunday night, and I'm tired after a long day.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈsʌndeɪ ˈnaɪt, ənd aɪm ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: My cousin Kwan is going to stay with us next weekend.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈkwɑːn ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsteɪ wɪð ʌs ˈnɛkst ˈwiːkɛnd.

passage.text: She's our guest, so the house has to be clean and tidy.
passage.reading: ʃiːz aʊər ˈɡɛst, soʊ ðə ˈhaʊs ˈhæs tə bi ˈkliːn ənd ˈtaɪdi.

passage.text: Here's my to-do list for this week.
passage.reading: hɪrz maɪ təˈduː lɪst fər ðɪs ˈwiːk.

passage.text: On Monday and Tuesday, I'm going to tidy my room.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ ənd ˈtuːzdeɪ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtaɪdi maɪ ˈruːm.

passage.text: On Wednesday, I'm going to buy some fruit and snacks for her.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈfruːt ənd ˈsnæks fər hɜːr.

passage.text: On Friday, I'm going to cook her favorite food.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈkʊk hɜːr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈfuːd.

passage.text: I'm not going to work next weekend, so we can go shopping together.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈwɜːrk ˈnɛkst ˈwiːkɛnd, soʊ wiː kən ˈɡoʊ ˈʃɑːpɪŋ təˈɡɛðər.
